ND-R5-B5-001.decision: Treat B5_RISK_INPUT_SNAPSHOT_V1 as a direct B1 canonical-inventory schema. Do NOT fabricate a new Canonical Manifest M-row. Its schema authority is the explicit B1 canonical inventory + current P-B5 field contract + current B5→B6 overrides.
ND-R5-B5-001.reason: Closes the missing-M-row ambiguity without changing the independently accepted 70-row mapping manifest or state/business architecture.
ND-R5-B5-001.source_phrase: B1 compatibility amendment explicitly lists snapshot_b5_risk_v1.json in canonical schema inventory; P-B5 defines B5_RISK_INPUT_SNAPSHOT fields.

ND-F1-001.decision: Preserve both source lexemes as fixed-present nullable fields source_uri and endpoint_class; require at least one non-null; neither field substitutes for the other.
ND-F1-001.reason: Eliminates slash ambiguity without inventing a combined semantic field.

ND-F1-002.decision: Preserve source names freshness_ttl and freshness_rule_id as fixed-present nullable fields; require at least one non-null. freshness_ttl uses FreshnessTTL{value:int>=0, unit:MILLISECONDS|SECONDS|MINUTES|HOURS|DAYS}; no unit default exists.
ND-F1-002.reason: Removes the v0.2 hidden seconds assumption; exact unit is data, not builder inference.

ND-F1-003.decision: Preserve provider_as_of and feed as separate fixed-present nullable fields; either/both may be null depending provider response.
ND-F1-003.reason: Distinct metadata axes; no authority inferred from absence.

ND-F1-004.decision: Represent as one opaque container http_status_result_metadata; B1 validates only JSON-map container shape and does not invent child fields.
ND-F1-004.reason: Avoids v0.2 decomposition into non-source-backed http_status_code/result_status.

ND-F1-005.decision: Represent as one opaque container error_retry_metadata; B1 validates only JSON-map container shape and does not invent child fields.
ND-F1-005.reason: Avoids v0.2 decomposition into non-source-backed error_metadata/retry_metadata.

ND-F1-006.decision: Preserve source groups as nested objects account, positions, open_orders, market_asset, context. account.status remains status inside account; snapshot-level status remains top-level status. Provider 'if available/optional' fields are fixed-present nullable leaves inside the owning group.
ND-F1-006.reason: Eliminates invented account_status collision rename while preserving the source's own namespace boundaries.
ND-F1-006.source_phrase: ACCOUNT / POSITIONS / OPEN ORDERS / MARKET / ASSET / B2/B3 CONTEXT grouped contract plus snapshot-level status

ND-R13-B5-OPENORDER-001.decision: Each open_order_exposure_record is a closed canonical risk projection with fixed-present state,side,notional,qty. notional/qty are DecimalWithUnit or explicit null; additional provider order fields remain outside canonical risk authority.
ND-R13-B5-OPENORDER-001.reason: P-B5 explicitly requires state/side/notional/qty for pending exposure and fail-closed INCOMPLETE_DATA when exposure cannot be valued.
ND-R13-B5-OPENORDER-001.source_phrase: order state/side/notional/qty must be represented; pending exposure deterministically valued or INCOMPLETE_DATA

ND-R13-B5-POSITION-001.decision: portfolio_position_values[] is a closed canonical risk projection with fixed-present qty,market_value,cost_basis,current_price; each value is DecimalWithUnit or explicit null. No additional provider fields are admitted into this canonical record.
ND-R13-B5-POSITION-001.reason: Current P-B5 identifies current position quantity, cost basis, market value and current price as provider facts. Raw provider payload remains traceable through positions_ref/positions_hash/provider receipts instead of leaking into deterministic risk authority.
ND-R13-B5-POSITION-001.source_phrase: current positions expose live position quantity, cost basis, market value and current price; portfolio_position_values[]; all numeric strings use Decimal with explicit units

ND-R5-AGG-001.decision: Remove builder-invented updated_at from AGGREGATE_HEAD_V1. Atomic update behavior is transaction semantics, not an extra source-defined projection field.
ND-R5-AGG-001.reason: B1 plan names no updated_at projection field.
ND-R5-AGG-001.source_phrase: aggregate_heads key properties: aggregate_type+aggregate_id; current_version; current_state; head_event_hash; updated atomically with append

ND-R5-B6-001.decision: Restore required non-null mandate_version while retaining current exact policy_refs/policy_lineage_hash override.
ND-R5-B6-001.reason: Policy refs do not replace mandate identity.

ND-R5-B6-002.decision: Restore required mandate_version while current policy versions remain represented by exact policy_refs/policy_lineage_hash.
ND-R5-B6-002.reason: Mandate identity is independent of policy identity.

ND-R5-B6-003.decision: Restore required mandate_version while retaining exact current policy refs and commit snapshot lineage.
ND-R5-B6-003.reason: Current execution authority requires mandate lineage through commit.
ND-R5-B6-003.source_phrase: COMMIT state must preserve the same mandate lineage under fresh commit revalidation

ND-R5-B6-004.decision: Restore required mandate_version while current policy versions remain exact policy_refs/policy_lineage_hash.
ND-R5-B6-004.reason: Policy identity is not a substitute for mandate identity.
ND-R5-B6-004.source_phrase: EXECUTION_INTENT stores mandate/risk/evidence/sizing policy versions and exact execution lineage

ND-R5-BSR-001.decision: Use those source fields exactly, plus canonical submit_receipt_id/receipt_hash from M046. Remove invented attempt_number/classification/provider_status/canonical_payload fields.
ND-R5-BSR-001.reason: Receipt is network-result evidence, not a second execution classifier or retry authority.
ND-R5-BSR-001.source_phrase: Broker Submit Receipt: intent_id, client_order_id, request_payload_hash, request_started_at, optional HTTP/status/request-id/body-hash/order/error data, transport_outcome

ND-R5-CONFLICT-001.decision: Materialize conflict_id, entity_id, field_or_claim, evidence_ids, conflict_class, material, status, authoritative_evidence_id, resolution_rule_ref, conflict_hash.
ND-R5-CONFLICT-001.reason: Each field is a structural representation of an already-required conflict axis; no source winner or resolution rule is invented.
ND-R5-CONFLICT-001.source_phrase: Store both conflicting EvidenceItems + ConflictRecord; classify material conflict; resolve by authoritative_for when a source is explicitly authoritative; unresolved material conflict remains visible.

ND-R5-DCC-001.decision: Materialize change_condition_id, description_claim_id, matcher_id/version, source_scope_refs, freshness_rule_ref, on_match=REVIEW_REQUIRED, condition_hash.
ND-R5-DCC-001.reason: Makes the non-executable review-trigger semantics machine-readable without granting deterministic invalidation or trade authority.
ND-R5-DCC-001.source_phrase: Non-deterministic/semantic decision-change condition promotes to DECISION_CHANGE_CONDITION_V1 with on_match=REVIEW_REQUIRED; current source/matcher/freshness context must remain bound.

ND-R5-EXE-001.decision: Restore the accepted execution lineage/result field set and add only canonical event_hash from M047.
ND-R5-EXE-001.reason: Provider-lifecycle-only representation lost the accepted proposal/snapshot/risk/request lineage.

ND-R5-IC-001.decision: Materialize condition_id, description_claim_id, evaluator_id/version, required_input_refs, operator, comparison_value_ref, freshness_rule_ref, on_true=THESIS_INVALIDATED, condition_hash.
ND-R5-IC-001.reason: No threshold/value is invented; comparison_value_ref must resolve exact PolicyValue/EvidenceItem/ComputedValue authority.
ND-R5-IC-001.source_phrase: B4 machine-evaluable invalidation requires description claim, evaluator/source/operator/comparison-value/freshness sufficient for deterministic validation; comparison value is exact canonical authority.

ND-R5-MANDATE-001.decision: Restore all three accepted execution_mode enum values. Keep live_execution=false. Capital-impacting execution remains separately gated to PAPER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
ND-R5-MANDATE-001.reason: v0.3 incorrectly deleted two valid non-write mandate modes.

ND-R5-MRR-001.decision: Materialize those observability axes as fixed-present fields (nullable only where source says when available/not applicable); include store=false/tools_enabled=false safety evidence; canonical model_run_id/receipt_hash from M016.
ND-R5-MRR-001.reason: Restores lost B3/B4 model-run lineage without making the receipt business or policy authority.
ND-R5-MRR-001.source_phrase: B3 per-call observability records run_id,candidate_id,stage,prompt/schema versions,research/model policy lineage,requested/effective model,reasoning,response id,input/research/output hashes,latency,usage incl cached tokens,validator results,repair/escalation reason,final status.

ND-R5-RECON-001.reason: Makes the existing bounded reconciliation algorithm durable without adding retry/cancel/replace authority.
ND-R5-RECON-001.source_phrase: Read-only reconciliation is keyed by intent_id/client_order_id, records bounded attempts/read evidence, may bind broker order/provider status, ends BROKER_ORDER_BOUND|NO_ORDER_PROVEN|BROKER_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, and never permits POST retry.

ND-R5-REOPEN-001.reason: Captures required lineage/rationale while preserving 'request, not transition edge' semantics.
ND-R5-REOPEN-001.source_phrase: research_reopen_required produces a durable reopen request; a new linked evaluation starts S00 with parent/reopen lineage; old aggregate is not directly transitioned.

ND-R5-RNV-001.decision: Materialize raw_numeric_value_id,evidence_id,field_or_claim,value Decimal,unit,as_of,normalization_version,value_hash. RawNumericValue contains no derived arithmetic.
ND-R5-RNV-001.reason: Uses source lexeme field_or_claim and preserves explicit numeric unit/provenance.
ND-R5-RNV-001.source_phrase: B2 EvidenceItem uses field_or_claim and normalized/direct numeric values with unit/context; M004 names RawNumericValue ID/hash.

ND-R5-SIZE-001.decision: Use those current variable names exactly; retain sizing policy ref, algorithm/input/hash/rounding/time and canonical computation ID/hash. No numeric policy value/default is embedded by builder.
ND-R5-SIZE-001.source_phrase: TARGET_WEIGHT_CAPPED_V1 algorithm variables target_position_notional,current_long_exposure,pending_buy_exposure,raw_increment; optional_absolute_base_notional_cap_usd; emit notional_usd + provenance.

ND-R8-PRR-001.decision: Only provider_as_of/feed are nullable because source marks them optional. The two grouped metadata containers remain required-present non-null JSON maps; their child semantics stay opaque.
ND-R8-PRR-001.reason: v0.3 incorrectly generalized optionality to the grouped metadata containers.
ND-R8-PRR-001.source_phrase: provider_as_of / feed optional; http/status/result metadata; error/retry metadata

ND-R9-B5-UNIT-001.decision: Every provider-derived numeric semantic admitted into the closed B5 canonical risk projection is represented as DecimalWithUnit{value,unit}; unit is required and has no default. Raw provider DTO extras do not enter canonical risk authority.
ND-R9-B5-UNIT-001.reason: Closes v0.4 bare numeric-string paths and avoids implicit units or generic untyped provider subtrees.
ND-R9-B5-UNIT-001.source_phrase: all numeric strings from provider are normalized to Decimal with explicit units
